rationale: v32 could not perform an authorized zero-fit false-negative audit because v29/v30 preserved thresholds and model hashes but no model states, Q2 scores, or Q2 action masks.
applies_to: new axes created after this amendment only

required_before_any_q2_target_access.ensemble_score_vector: one label-blind Q2 score per authenticated row position
required_before_any_q2_target_access.candidate_action_masks: one fixed-budget add-only Q2 mask for every pre-Q2 threshold candidate, including candidates rejected by environment gates
required_before_any_q2_target_access.model_state_hashes: one deterministic hash per fitted seed and scaler state
required_before_any_q2_target_access.row_positions_and_incumbent: authenticated Q2 row positions and frozen anchor prediction
required_before_any_q2_target_access.threshold_receipts: numeric threshold, source quantile, action count, and action share
required_before_any_q2_target_access.artifact_hashes: SHA-256 for score/action bundle and manifest
